scope: One reviewer rated five blinded candidates, one per method or random baseline, from a focused 44-paper vector-search and visual-retrieval corpus.

ratings.title: Brain-Inspired Multimodal Spiking Neural Network for Image-Text Retrieval
Aggregating Neighbor Embedding Projection and Rank-Based Manifold Learning for Image Retrieval
RS-JEPA: Remote Sensing Joint-Embedding Predictive Architecture with Scan-Path Views for Cross-Sensor Image Retrieval
Dynamic Graph Indexing for Label-Filtered Approximate Nearest Neighbor Search
Calibrated Early Termination with Bounded Optimality Gaps for Constrained Vector Search

limitations: Each selection method has one observation; no reliable method comparison or superiority claim.
Corpus queries, two-domain scope, and source-cluster selection were designed for reviewer familiarity.
Paper summaries were paraphrased from abstracts; full-paper claims were not independently verified.
The proposed 40-paper review was abandoned and contributes no completed-review results.

provenance.ratings_source: Human ratings and assessability answers supplied in the conversation on 2026-11-17.
provenance.assessability_question: Enough context to score boundary relevance and cross-topic value?
provenance.reviewer_notes: No explanations accompanied the numerical ratings.
provenance.selection_blinding: The selection key was disclosed only after all five numerical ratings were supplied.

setup.selection: First unused candidate in each method pool for the specified source; random pool shuffled first; hull vertices use corpus order, not rank. Shuffle final five.
setup.context: Named topic descriptions and three representative-paper summaries per topic, excluding all candidates, with links to original abstracts.

queries: (ti:"approximate nearest neighbor" OR ti:"vector search") AND (cat:cs.DB OR cat:cs.DS OR cat:cs.IR OR cat:cs.LG)
ti:"image retrieval" AND (all:descriptor OR all:embedding OR all:instance)
corpus.purpose: Usability pilot on vector indexing, visual retrieval, and image-text retrieval; not an unbiased field sample.

setup.reproduction_limit: The archived scores and setup record what was reviewed. The historical sample/report commands use the abandoned protocol and cannot regenerate or report this pilot.
